lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
primary_blocker: Relational: must manage/inform the existing letting agent before signing. Underlying: unresolved trust in Stayful as a company (legitimacy, what happens if it dissolves, wanting to physically verify the operation) rather than any price objection.
language_signals: hands-off / retirement framing ("I want to retire now so I want to be hands off")
business-literate self-framing ("we're business people, we know how business works")
trust-and-verification seeking language (company house checks, wanting to see a managed property)
phased/incremental caution language ("slowly see how they feel before we sign this")

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: we can't kick them out ... we can't force them out we can't get them out
delay_signals.context: Property is a licensed 7-bed HMO with six sitting tenants who cannot be served notice except on sale of the property; plan is to transition room-by-room only as tenants leave naturally.
delay_signals.timeline_given: "I find every six months people leave anyway" / one room imminently vacant, others unspecified

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: Before we sign it we need to let the agent know
delay_signals.context: Lead must first manage the conversation with their existing letting agent (who currently re-lets vacated HMO rooms) before signing with Stayful, because the agent will lose business.

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: there's no mortgage with the property then / Them: Now.
green_light_signals.context: Property owned outright, no mortgage, no debt service; only running costs are utilities (~£1,000-£1,200/month). Financially unconstrained to proceed.

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: I want to retire now so I want to be hands off
green_light_signals.context: Explicit stated desire to move from self/agent-managed HMO to fully hands-off management; frequent travellers who want the property taken off their hands.

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: as soon as somebody moved out ... we can go through the changeover ... we can still start with one or two rooms
green_light_signals.context: One HMO room imminently vacant; lead is ready to begin the phased transition immediately once the agent conversation and agreement are sorted.

offer_timing.offer_outcome: No offer made; standard 15% + VAT quoted with no discount and no expiry, and it went entirely unchallenged on price.

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought we'd start just sort of understanding a bit about your situation.
rapport_topics: £150k pandemic-era renovation (new roof, full strip-out, all rooms ensuite)
proximity to Harrogate train/coach station and conference centre
property's former life as a 30-year guest house
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: What I'll do then is I'll go through the income projections for the property first.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So we're looking at about 141,000 of gross revenue per year and about 73,000, 73 and a half thousand net revenue. So about six thousand pounds per month.
meeting_flow.post_income_silence: None observed — lead immediately queried whether the £6,000 figure was monthly and asked how many properties Zac personally manages in Harrogate.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: I don't know if you've got any questions about the service or any of the projections... I can go through other service works. If you got any questions, I can answer about 30 now or [I could just go through how it works].
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: Anything else you want to go for any more concerns you've got or, or we all[?]
meeting_flow.close_phrase: Well, I'll send everything over to you. Probably next sort of 20 minutes. I'll send you over the agreement. If you obviously looking to go ahead, just sign that ... send it back to me and we'll get going.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: So our 6,000 is it monthly or is monthly?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: That's a monthly average. Yeah. Six thousand.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: This is what you this is based on your experience, you how many properties you run in Harrogate our airbnb.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: So where are the three Airbnb in Harrogate, in which area? ... Specifically in Harrogate.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: I can't remember off the top of my head... I think one's on bower road. I think that's hg2. It's like a two bed flower.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: engaging or entrusting our property to a company we don't know is a risk... if it is suddenly dissolved or struck off then there is no way we can chase the company for compensation
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: we essentially have a holding account where all the booking Revenue comes into that account that's not attached to Stayful, really... the income that is generated for you is owed to you.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: What is the exit process procedure especially if there are still some bookings after we want to end the contract

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What is the exit process procedure especially if there are still some bookings after we want to end the contract so how do you deal with it?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: we have a six month fixed term and a three month notice term... we have an agreed cut off date... we can service all the bookings, we'll pay out the normal way, and then we just cut ties on that agreed date.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: it's easy to sign... oh my goodness you're going to six months go one year... first thing we always ask, how do you get out.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Can we go in and as a guest and just have a look of how [it works]? ... we have not worked with Stayful before so it's really help if we can have a look of the property you're operating here.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: I don't think we'll be able to do that... it's someone else's property... I've got to ask consent from a landlord with a nearby property to access.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: please don't attend to 15% on top of the of the bill, how do you charge that?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: if the guests at fault, we collect a deposit... if it's something really serious, covered by our insurance... if fair wear and tear, charged to yourself. We notify you if the account exceeds £300 in the month.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: you will let us know your quote before you proceed right unless it's emergency like water leak.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: once we take off the hmo we need to apply again or we don't get it... they literally said you just go out, we're not going to give you again.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: I would still say that part's kind of up to you a little bit because you will lose the license and the license will make the property a lot more valuable. So it might be worth just maybe holding off and keeping an eye.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: we've got most of it all done anyway.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: do you guarantee rent as well? ... do your company do guarantee rent for the whole property.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No... I'm not taking on any more of those Arrangements at the moment.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: But the one in [Sheffield] is vacant now, no tenant.

positive_shift_moments.lead_response: "we can also do that as well, yeah of course."

positive_shift_moments.lead_response: No pushback; conversation moved constructively into how the phased transition would work operationally.

positive_shift_moments.what_caused_shift: Zac's advice to HOLD the HMO licence rather than surrender it early, actively advising against an irreversible step that would benefit him commercially
positive_shift_moments.lead_response: "we've got most of it all done anyway."

analogies_used: Same as if you had, like, a lettings agent, they take the money for you. It's not necessarily attached to their business.
zac_language.numbers_framing: Presented a low/likely/high case (£3,400 worst month / £6,000 average / £9,000 best month net) rather than a single point figure, then anchored the property's rarity/quality against two named nearby comparables (£209k and £115k gross).
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Acknowledges the concern directly, explains Stayful's operational mechanism (holding account, insurance, notice terms, £300 approval threshold) in plain terms, then checks in with a follow-up question ("does that help at all?") rather than pushing straight to close.

what_they_focused_on: company legitimacy and financial safety (dissolution/struck-off risk)
wanting to physically verify Stayful's operation
what_they_needed_most: proof Stayful is a trustworthy, stable, long-term operator
a way to verify the service independent of Zac's word (e.g. a reference call or site visit)
explicit acknowledgement that this is a phased, tenant-respectful transition, not a forced conversion
what_fell_flat: Zac's inability to name or locate Stayful's own Harrogate-managed properties
the declined request to view/stay at a managed property, with no alternative offered live on the call
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: Come prepared with named local property examples and proactively offer a reference call with an existing owner as the direct answer to the company-trust objection, rather than waiting for the lead to raise viewing requests.
